_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): React Error Boundary with retry UI — prevents a crashed subtree from killing the whole app. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-error-boundary
description: React Error Boundary with retry button + optional onError hook. Wrap risky subtrees so one crash never kills the app.
notes: Usage: <ErrorBoundary onError={(e)=>console.error(e)}><Dashboard/></ErrorBoundary>. Retry resets the boundary state and re-renders children. Wrap async-loaded pages, charts, and third-party widgets.
